messages.text: Hey, I just saw your post for the room for rent, I’m Tim, I currently work full time for the QLD Government as an environmental Officer. I’m 26 and spent the last 8 years living in share houses while at university and also working as an environmental Scientist. I spend most of my time hanging out with friends, watching live music , reading and sometimes having the occasional drink. I’m an easy going and clean person. My Instagram has a fair few photos and may give you a better understanding of my personality and myself. Happy to call and answer any questions that you may have.
